targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, dimensions->>'cloudflare_queue_name' as metric, max((dimensions->>'lag_p95_ms')::numeric) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.queue.delivery.batch' and deleted_at is null group by 1, 2 order by 1

select date_trunc('minute', recorded_at) as time, dimensions->>'cloudflare_queue_name' as metric, sum(metric_value) as value from runtime_telemetry_metrics where metric_name = 'letbuyy.queue.dead_letter.total' and deleted_at is null group by 1, 2 order by 1
select queue_name, operation_type, status, affected_count, created_at from queue_recovery_operations where deleted_at is null order by created_at desc limit 50
